text:
anika: Heads-up: launching the "Lighthouse" nurture tied to the benchmarks webinar + product playbooks next Tue. Need final segment CSV, send windows, subject families, and a short cadence. Pinging thread to consolidate.

samir: Thumbs up. Proposal for local send windows: APAC 08:30 local, NA 11:00 local, EMEA 16:00 local. Keep the live reminders timezone-aware.

pippa: Segment draft (paste CSV):
```
segment_id,filter,notes
lighthouse_trial_7d,trial_start<=7d,high-intent trialers
lighthouse_engaged_21d,last_open<=21d,active engagers
lighthouse_dormant_200d,last_engagement>200d,reactivation test
```
Exclude users with tag `privacy_review` or unsubscribed in 30d. Also exclude any account marked for enterprise-only outreach.

anika: Creative asks: two subject families: "technical" (benchmarks + configs) and "outcome" (cost/latency wins). Keep one short subject variant <=45 chars for mobile. Pippa, can you draft CTAs?

pippa: CTA options: 1) "Register for benchmark webinar" 2) "See quickstart + configs" 3) "Get a tailored cost brief". Preheaders: "Benchmarks & configs inside" / "Join our live walkthrough".

lin: Ops notes: daily quota 1.1M. Recommend concurrency 180, batch size 120, ramp 10m. Set provider throttle to 5k/min. If 5xx > 2.5% for 5m, failover to backup and move failing recipients to s3://marketing/lighthouse/fallback.csv. Add soft pause rule: pause region if bounce_rate>2.7% over 20m.

samir: A/B plan: engaged_21d -> 60/40 technical/outcome. Trial_7d -> prioritize outcome (70/30). Dormant_200d -> even split and stronger urgency language. We'll track signups, watch-to-register, and trial activations 7d.

anika: Cadence: invite -> 48h follow-up -> 3-day reminder -> 2h live nudge -> post-webinar recap + playbook link. For trial_7d shorten to invite -> 24h -> 48h -> recap.

pippa: RSVP survey: single-question (primary use-case). Use answer to route recipients to SDR lists via tag `lighthouse_usecase:<answer>`. Add UTM params: utm_campaign=lighthouse_v1&utm_source=email&utm_medium=campaign. Also set `X-Campaign: lighthouse_v1` header for analytics.

sendy-bot: Detected file upload at s3://marketing/lighthouse/segments_v2.csv. Validating headers and sample sizes. checksum: md5: 9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015.

lin: Confirmed. Scheduling epoch 2143723200 for first send. Concurrency 180, batch 120, ramp 10m. Failover file set. Also configured per-region soft pauses and a monitoring alert to #deliverability if complaint_rate>1% over 10m.

anika: One more: creative will include a small inline chart (PNG) of token cost vs latency. Keep AMP/interactive components out for deliverability. Pippa will attach full playbook in the post-webinar recap.

samir: Can we gate some sends to RD team for high-touch accounts? Add filter `account_tier=enterprise` -> route to manual approval before send.

lin: Added pre-send gate: enterprise segment will be marked `pending_approval` and not included until RD confirm. Ops will hold those recipients in s3://marketing/lighthouse/pending_approval.csv.

anika: Great. Post-send debrief: measure opens, clicks, register-to-attend, watch-to-convert, trial activation 7d, and token-cost delta for attendees who convert. Schedule debrief Thu 9am PT. I'll post final plan + S3 link in #marketing and pin. Thanks team! :lighthouse:

pippa: Uploaded final CSV snapshot and sample counts in thread. Total recipients across segments: 78,400.

sendy-bot: Upload completed and checksum matched. Job scheduled.
